sources.name: B_GALLERY-permit.txt
sources.text:
Powered moving platforms may not cross the gallery resin finish without written collections-team consent.

The issued variation for Scene 401 alone allows the motorized tracking base only with sacrificial runner sheets and an on-site floor warden present throughout the take.

An unsigned application asks to extend this variation to Scene 402; the application has not been issued as a binding amendment.
